proposed_widenings.name: dissolve_adhesive
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core deterministic mechanic is removing adhesive coverage from a touched surface by area spent; no existing surfaced effect atom expresses that world-state change honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.surface_or_object
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations currently cannot attach to a non-creature surface/object target within reach.
proposed_widenings.evidence: pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.utilize
proposed_widenings.justification: The item explicitly consumes the Utilize action, which is more specific than the existing generic action activation cost.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Utilize action

proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.random_initial_quantity
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's consumable pool is initialized randomly when found, which the current fixed/tiered/linear/proficiency/ability cap model cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

notes: No content file was authored. The existing magic_item activation family is close on consumable-item shape, but the item still requires a new adhesive-dissolution effect atom plus surface/object targeting to avoid a misleading trace.
